m: नड or नळ, m. (L. also n.) a species of reed, Arundo Tibialis or Karka, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; N. of a prince with the patr. Naiṣidha, ŚBr. (= Nala Naiṣadha Sch.); of a Nāga, L.; of a partic. tribe whose employment is making a sort of glass bracelet, W. (cf. नल).
a: नडः --डं — A species of reed. --डः N. of a tribe preparing a sort of bracelets. --Comp. --अगारं, --आगारं a hut of reeds. --प्राय a. abounding in reeds. --भक्तं a place abounding in reeds. --वनं a thicket of reeds. --संहतिः f. a collection or quantity of reeds.
